verdict.rationale: Drata documents its own connections feature ('Understanding Connections in Drata') and says it connects tools to automate evidence collection; its open-source device agent is documented as having read-only access to system settings. The pack does not show a catalog naming cloud, identity, HR, code-hosting, MDM or ticketing integrations, and gives no read-only scope details for those connections. Missing for 10: a documented integrations catalog covering each named category, read-only scope documentation per integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can connect my real stack — cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM, ticketing — through a documented integrations catalog with read-only scopes
